services.name: Other Private Events
services.desc: Surrounded by lush greenery, vibrant florals and breathtaking views, the Garden offers a stunning backdrop for weddings, events and celebrations of all kinds. From secluded vistas to sprawling garden lawns, immerse yourself in nature and explore our 37 acres of botanical bliss. With a mild year-round climate, the Garden’s unique outdoor settings are perfect for nature-lovers and include an idyllic Victorian Gazebo Lawn, historic Lawn House Garden and an intimate Waterfall Deck. Our magnificent glass enclosed Conservatory offers an indoor/outdoor multi-use space filled with exquisite rare and unusual plants. services.name: Summer Nights
services.desc: Spend your summer evenings surrounded by music, blooms, and golden hour with the return of Summer Nights! This popular outdoor concert series transforms the Gazebo Lawn into a lively gathering place filled with live performances, beautiful scenery, and laid-back summer fun. From the twang and two-stepping of Country Night to the rad retro vibes of 80s Night, each concert features a themed experience. Concerts begin at 5:30 p.m., with live music continuing through 7:15 p.m. Pack a picnic blanket, enjoy a drink, and relax on the Lawn as the Garden comes alive with the sounds of summer! services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: SDBG is excited to offer school and youth groups an immersive oasis where nature’s lessons lead the way. Ready to explore? Our K-12 field trip season operates for eight months out of the year, divided into two sessions: Spring (February-June) and Fall (August-October). To reserve a field trip for your class or youth group, purchase an SDBG Field Trip Pass. Each pass is $250.00 and admits up to 30 students and 6 adults. Similar to General Admission, Field Trips are booked via our Programs Calendar! Find more registration details during the booking process. Are you a Title I school? SDBG is proud to offer funding to support your admission and/or transportation
